security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Run open-weight language models on your own machine. Search and download from Hugging Face, load a model, chat with it, and serve an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost — with the model and runtime identity recorded for every completion.
bundle._resources_note: The release workflow stages `misaka-studiod` here before bundling. The shell finds it beside its own executable (`locate_runtime_binary`), which is what makes an installed app self-contained: the user needs no Rust, no Node and no PATH entry. The directory is kept in git with a .gitkeep so this glob always matches something — whether an empty glob is an error is Tauri behaviour this repository cannot test, since the Windows bundle is only ever built by CI.
